title: How AI Predicts the Next Word (real run of Qwen2.5-0.5B)

scenes.text: ChatGPT has no favorite color. So how does it answer?

scenes.text: I ran a small open AI model on the sentence: My favorite color is. First, it cuts the text into tokens, each with an ID number.

scenes.text: Then each token becomes a list of 896 numbers.

scenes.text: Those numbers flow through 24 layers. In each one, tokens look back at earlier tokens, and the numbers change.
